testType: Varied scripted four-action replay with observational shot-release pressure and keeper placement
limitations: Scripted policy is not a human player; match statistics are not human win rates
Six scripted fixtures per difficulty remain insufficient to estimate human skill, win rates or retune GK save probabilities
Tied regulation scores are followed by in-engine penalty shootouts and recorded separately
Snapshot distances are game-world units; pressure bands are diagnostic labels, not calibrated scoring quality or xG
Performance on physical gamepads and phones is not tested
